title: Munich Motor Imagery dataset
description: EEG recordings from 10 healthy participants performing two-class motor imagery (left vs. right hand) cued by arrow stimuli. Data were acquired with a 128-channel BrainAmp system at 500 Hz, with 150 trials per class. The dataset was originally collected to evaluate beamforming and spatial filtering approaches (CSP, Laplacian) for noninvasive brain-computer interfaces, and is distributed here in BIDS format via MOABB.
methods_description: 128-channel EEG was recorded with a BrainAmp amplifier at 500 Hz, referenced to Cz, with impedances below 10 kOhm, in a shielded room. Participants imagined haptic movements of the left or right hand during arrow cue display (7 s). Data were re-referenced offline to common average reference with no trial rejection or artifact correction.
